## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List relevant checks and device/API versions. For UI changes, include screenshots of affected themes and sizes.

- [ ] Relevant build, tests and lint pass.
- [ ] Public source audit passes; no keys, personal data, APKs or build logs added.
- [ ] Documentation, privacy text and dependency notices updated when affected.

## Known limitations

Mention anything a reviewer needs to assess before merging.
